knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Returned product can carry skin cells and organisms into the whole container, which then reaches the next client.
Disinfection needs the full label contact time. Storing or using the tool early leaves the disinfection step incomplete.
The lesson says disposable applicators, spatulas, wax sticks, cotton items and gloves are discarded after each client. Reusable tools are cleaned and then disinfected instead.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate decant product for a simulated client into a clean dish and discard or clean the dish, without returning product to the main container
Assessor observes the candidate clean and then disinfect a reusable tool, and check the time against the label contact time recorded in the record
Assessor observes hand hygiene before and after a simulated client, following the approved procedure
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Cleaning and disinfection record with product name and contact time
Photo or observation note of the decanting method used
Record of the single-use items used and disposed of
stopWorkCriteria: Used product is returned to the main container
A reusable tool is used before the disinfection contact time has passed
Used items and sharps are left in the clean area of the kit
